cases.text:
Thanks for reaching out! Unfortunately, a post-purchase price adjustment policy isn't something covered in the policy documents I have access to, so I'm not able to give you a definitive answer on that. I'd recommend reaching out to us directly (phone, email, or chat) to ask our team whether a price adjustment is available for your order — I wouldn't want to guess either way.

What I can tell you from our policies is that **we do not offer price matching with other retailers** (kb/11-promotions.md), but that only speaks to competitor pricing, not to our own sales.

If there's anything else I can help you with — like checking your order status or starting a return — just let me know!
